title: The Amazon Judgment and expansion of the proportionality principle
description: The doctrine of proportionality is being increasingly deployed by Indian courts to test the legality of State action, particularly where public power affects individual rights, commercial outcomes or institutional fairness.The recent judgment of the Supreme Court in the Amazon case marks an important milestone in this jurisprudential evolution.
